1. SSH 到 westd-11672，读取 log 文件全文

- pass@1: X%
- n_total: N
- stderr: X (如有)
- checkpoint_path: /path/to/model (从日志中提取)
- log_path: ~/runs/recovery_aware_struct_prune/eval_humaneval_grpo_rasp_20.log
